newsitem.title: CANADA: WCE names former CSCE head as its new president.
newsitem.headline: WCE names former CSCE head as its new president.

text.p: The board of governors of the Winnipeg Commodity Exchange said on Tuesday it named former Coffee, Sugar and Cocoa Exchange president Bennett Corn as the WCE's new president and chief executive, a WCE statement said.

"During Mr. Corn's tenure at the CSCE, trading costs were reduced more than 55 percent and exchange volume increased from one million to 12 million contracts per year," WCE chairman Terry James said in the statement.
The WCE had sought a new president since Fred Siemens stepped down October 31, 1996. Corn's appointment takes effect March 31, 1997.
Corn acted as president and chief executive of New York's CSCE for 19 years, the statement said.
